pages.text: The $(item)Huge Explore Skyseed$() — four $(item)huge$() biome seeds ringed around a spare structure seed. It grows a $(bold)huge$() island of the local biome and forces the largest structures onto it.
Ring four huge biome seeds around any structure seed — it is spent to make one.
$(bold)The grand tour$()$(br)The biggest dungeons and forts need the huge tier to fit — this is the seed that hosts them. Endgame exploration: expensive, but the finest finds.
